title.narrative: Climate impacts on children in Laos are intensifying evidenced by Typhoon Yagi with humanitarian support provided under the Lao PDR Inter Agency Contingency Plan. Following the launch of the children’s climate risk assessment and strategy, innovative approaches for climate adaptation include a sub-national climate risk index, air quality monitoring, and green schools. The engagement of youth in Government-led climate policy instruments aims to secure increased attention and financing for child-sensitive climate adaptation
